title: Prevent Trap Siphonage with Correct P-Trap Venting
description: A fixture P-trap relies on a standing water seal to block dangerous sewer gases from entering living spaces. A common issue occurs when a drain line lacks proper venting, creating a hydraulic vacuum that siphons the water seal out of the trap dip as waste rushes down the line. To ensure reliable performance, maintain the correct distance between the trap weir and the vent connection according to local plumbing codes. Proper venting balances atmospheric pressure, allowing water to drain smoothly while preserving the standing water seal inside the P-trap.

A fixture P-trap relies on a standing water seal to block dangerous sewer gases from entering living spaces. A common issue occurs when a drain line lacks proper venting, creating a hydraulic vacuum that siphons the water seal out of the trap dip as waste rushes down the line. To ensure reliable performance, maintain the correct distance between the trap weir and the vent connection according to local plumbing codes. Proper venting balances atmospheric pressure, allowing water to drain smoothly while preserving the standing water seal inside the P-trap.
